judge. Checked in part: data stores and backups, external surface, hosts. On ubuntu, 6 of 16 host

1  medium  This Node.js release line no longer receives security fixes (ubuntu)
   [node.line_unsupported]
   Subject       nodejs (package nodejs)
   Observed      pkg.dpkg_runtimes#1 (07:12, as deploy): nodejs 20.11.1-1nodesource1 (dpkg)
   Observed      os.release#1 (07:12, as deploy): ID=debian VERSION_ID=12
   Concluded from check:pkg.dpkg_runtimes, check:os.release
   Severity      medium
   Why here      Node.js 20.11.1-1nodesource1 (NodeSource) is on the 20 line, which reached end of
                 life on 2026-04-30. The Node.js project publishes no fix for it: its 21 October
                 2026 release fixes 22, 24 and 26 only and says end-of-life versions are always
                 affected. Its Brotli decoder flaw is CVE-2026-111497.
   Not checked   Read: PHP and Node.js packages from dpkg and rpm. Not read: containers and their
                 images; Homebrew and installs from source; nvm, volta, asdf and fnm installs in
                 home directories; control-panel PHP (cPanel, Plesk, CloudLinux); Node.js inside
                 applications; other programs that bundle Brotli; whether running processes were
                 restarted after an update. Advisories published after 2026-10-24, the date of this
                 build's table, are not known to it
   Fix           Move to a Node.js line the project still fixes (nodejs.org lists them), test your
                 application, and restart it.
                 Caveat: A distribution's package of an older line is fixed by the distribution, not
                   by this rule's line.

IF YOU DECIDE NOT TO FIX A FINDING
Only for a risk you decide not to fix, and decided by whoever owns it: write the engagement to a
file (--write-engagement FILE), add yourself under people, paste the entry under
intent.accepted_risks in that file and write the reason, then run `scheck run FILE` from then on.

  # This Node.js release line no longer receives security fixes (ubuntu)
    - id: node.line_unsupported
      asset: ubuntu
      subject: nodejs              # required: this entry accepts this one only
      reason: ""                   # why this is acceptable here; required
      accepted_by: ""              # your handle under people
      date: 2026-10-07             # the day this acceptance is written
      expires: 2027-04-05          # after this date the finding counts again
                                   # until someone re-reviews it
